gallery.title: File:Norodom Sihamoni (2007).jpg
gallery.artist: Reinaldo Albeiro Rodas Torres from Sihanoukville, Cambodia
gallery.credit: King Norodom Sihamoni visiting Don Bosco Sihanoukvill
gallery.description: On February 12, 2007, the King of Cambodia, His Majesty Norodom Sihamoni, visited the Don Bosco Technical School of Sihanoukville and opened officially the Don Bosco Hotel School. The King wanted to pay a visit to the young people who are learning a skill and who come from poor conditions in the south of Cambodia. At his side is Fr. John Visser, a Dutch Salesian missionary who is the current Rector of the school.

gallery.filename: Global Forest Change tree-cover loss year in Preah Sihanouk, 2001-2024.png
gallery.title: File:Global Forest Change tree-cover loss year in Preah Sihanouk, 2001-2024.png
gallery.source: Global Forest Change tree-cover loss year in Preah Sihanouk, 2001-2024
gallery.description: Map of annual tree-cover loss year in the Global Forest Change dataset for Preah Sihanouk. Pixels with tree cover of at least 30% in 2000 and no mapped loss through 2024 are shown in green; pixels with mapped tree-cover loss are coloured by the first detected loss year from 2001 to 2024; land below the 30% tree-cover threshold in 2000 is shown in white; ocean areas are shown in pale blue.
